title: Fix code search limit behavior and result detail UX
description: Problem: Code Search accepted higher per-query limits in the UI but the backend still clamped results to `CodeSearch.MaxResults`, which remained 10 by default, making the limit control misleading. The result experience also needed explicit snippet copy, expandable context, and a sidebar/detail-card layout. Desired outcome: make the effective result cap honest and useful, ensure requested limits above 10 can actually return more than 10 when configured, and keep the richer snippet/detail affordances first-class.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from repeated operator feedback: status progress was one issue, but the deeper UX gap was that the visible per-query limit did not match the actual backend cap and the results pane needed first-class snippet copy/expand/detail workflows.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented the fix across `CodeSearch.razor`, `MemorySmithOptions.cs`, `appsettings.json`, and `AdminSettingsService.cs`. The operator cap now defaults to 100 and is exposed in admin config (`MemorySmith:CodeSearch:MaxResults`), the page shows the effective cap, and the result UX now includes sidebar selection, snippet copy, file-name copy, file+line copy, and expandable context. Focused regression coverage passed in `TagGovernanceTests` and `AppApiContractTests`.
